list.title: Orders
list.searchLabel: Order number, buyer name or email
list.count: {count, plural, =0 {No orders} one {One order} other {# orders}}

detail.title: Order {number}
detail.name: Name
detail.orderCreated: The order was created and the payment link was emailed to the buyer.

tracking.title: Manual tracking
tracking.intro: For a parcel sent outside the integrated carriers. The full fulfillment screen (packing checklist, customs, labels) comes later.
tracking.handedOver: The parcel was handed to the carrier

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.FULFILLMENT_BLOCKED: Fulfillment is blocked for this order.
errors.NOT_A_CARRIER_SHIPMENT: Pickup and artist delivery have no tracking.
errors.SHIPMENT_STATE: Tracking cannot be recorded in the shipment's current state.
errors.TRACKING_NUMBER_IN_USE: This tracking number is already used by another shipment.
errors.REFUND_EXCEEDS_CAPTURED: The amount is more than what was captured and not yet refunded.
errors.NOTHING_CAPTURED: No money was captured in this attempt.
errors.NOT_FAILED: The refund is not in the failed state.
errors.FAILURE_NOT_CONFIRMED: First confirm in the provider dashboard that no money was refunded.
errors.NOT_UNKNOWN: The refund is no longer unknown.
errors.PAYMENT_IN_FLIGHT: A payment is being confirmed; please try again later.
errors.AMOUNT_MISMATCH: The amount must equal the order total exactly.
errors.IL_REQUIRES_ILS: An order to Israel must be in ILS.
errors.PRICE_REASON_REQUIRED: The price differs from the list price; please give a reason.
errors.NOT_RESERVABLE: The artwork cannot be held right now.
errors.ORDER_NOT_PAYABLE: A payment cannot be recorded for the order in its current state.
errors.PRICE_REQUIRED: The artwork has no price in this currency; please enter one.

refundReason.LOST_RESERVATION: The work was no longer available

refund.title: Refund – attempt #{seq}
refund.intro: The refund is sent to the payment provider. It cannot exceed what was captured and not yet refunded.
refund.confirm: Refund this amount to the buyer? This cannot be undone.
refund.done: The refund was sent. Its status will update here.
refund.freshHint: Money action: if you signed in more than 30 minutes ago you will be asked to sign in again.
refund.markDoneHint: After you returned the money by transfer or in the provider dashboard.
refund.confirmFailed: I checked the provider dashboard: no money was refunded
refund.confirmFailedConfirm: Confirm you checked the provider dashboard and no refund was made? You can then retry.
refund.unknownHint: It is not known whether the refund went through. Never retry blindly: check with the provider or in its dashboard.
refund.resolveRefunded: I checked the dashboard: the refund went through
refund.resolveNotRefunded: I checked the dashboard: no refund was made
refund.resolveConfirm: Record the result of your check? This cannot be undone.

documents.manual: Record a document issued by hand

payment.title: Record a payment received
payment.intro: For a payment by transfer, cash or Bit outside the site. The amount must equal the order total exactly.
payment.confirm: Record a payment of the order total? The order becomes paid and the buyer gets a confirmation.

unpaid.cancel: Cancel the order and release the work
unpaid.cancelConfirm: Cancel the unpaid order and release the work?

new.title: Manual order
new.intro: For a buyer who wrote by WhatsApp, phone or email. One order is created at a locked price and the work is held. The buyer gets a payment link (with the same disclosures and deadlines), or you can record a payment received.
new.name: Buyer name
new.currencyHint: Delivery in Israel is always in ILS.
new.priceHint: Empty = the list price in the chosen currency.
new.priceChangeHint: Required when the price differs from the list price.
new.conversation: There was a conversation with the buyer before the order
new.conversationHint: Defaults to yes: it extends the cancellation window for eligible buyers (4 months).
new.submit: Create the order and send the link
new.confirm: Create an order at this price and email the buyer a payment link?
